sections.kicker: Prepared for Nico Schinowski by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Your best line and your best story are both on Instagram, at the end of the bio.
sections.keep: Your bio line, "Du hast noch viel vor. Wir entwickeln den Körper dafür." It sells a future, not a workout.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The bio lists four services every coach offers.
pins.why: A list says what you do, not why Nico and not the gym down the street.
pins.how: Keep the list for the services page and let the promise lead.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Prospects compare you with other coaches on price per session.

pins.what: Your military past sits at the very end of the bio.
pins.why: It is the one thing no other performance coach can copy, and it explains your standards.
pins.how: Make the background the reason behind your method, on the site and in the grid.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The story that makes you different stays hidden behind a more link.

pins.area: The home page opens on the name in giant letters over a portrait in a cap
pins.what: The home page opens on your name in giant letters over a portrait.
pins.why: The name leads, the promise does not appear, so a stranger meets a person and not a reason.
pins.how: Open with your bio line and let the name sign it.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Visitors who do not know you yet have nothing to hold on to.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Nico Schinowski's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
